$comment: Interim slicing map for art/reference/panda-sheet-v1.png (Cristian's character concept sheet, 1536x1024, flat black background, AI 'fake' pixel art). Boxes are [x, y, w, h] in sheet pixels and are the UNION bbox of each frame's components (body + detached paws), measured by flood-filling the background (max RGB channel <= backgroundThreshold) from the sheet borders and labelling 8-connected components. Do not pad. Assign every component of >= 20 px to the box it intersects; drop flat blobs (h <= 10, w > 3h, top at or below body bottom - 12): detached ground shadows. Frames keep ARRAY order (panda-air is deliberately not left-to-right). One scale factor for the whole sheet (`scale`, = 48 / the idle frames' 113 px height). The pipeline uses these frames ONLY when art/raw/<id>.png does not exist.

derived.$comment: Interim strips animated from ONE sliced frame (win over `strips` for the same id; a raw delivery still wins over both). panda-idle: the concept sheet's IDLE row is front-facing while every other strip is a side profile, so the panda turned to the camera whenever it stopped. Instead the standing walk frame (index 1) breathes: `cuts` are rows above the feet (12 = mid-belly, 30 = just under the face), and frame f lifts everything above cuts[k] by lifts[f][k] whole pixels (belly up 1, then the head 1 more) while the feet stay on the baseline.

unusedRows: attack (potion), hurt, die, special/power-up, directional front/back/left, map-icon sizes and extras are not used by the side-scroller; the special/power-up pose is the style reference for panda-celebrate; `sprites.panda-right` (the RIGHT directional sprite) seeds art/reference/panda-right-64.png, the PixelLab reference.
